blockers.title: The rebuilt predecessor record still omits four frozen lineage versions and their eight verdict files.
blockers.claimAttacked: basedOn.predecessorPinningShape says this subject pins every predecessor and every Stage A verdict that exists on disk, while authorityClaim introduces its recital as the lineage's own history.
evidence: Twelve frozen predecessor subjects exist at mode 0444: preview-product-boundary-successor.v1 through preview-product-boundary-successor.v12. basedOn has predecessorV5 through predecessorV12 only; predecessorV1, predecessorV2, predecessorV3, and predecessorV4 are absent.

The four omitted frozen subject digests are v1 50cb8c71ab1526e0351ce7c5d21db7169a308c46c7ab9b41b0d992ffd704178a, v2 f3e91157b981713b709772239f69418f77d13f349d56504d81c0e2aac9270914, v3 d4e0eae671545795a0f9de5d66344834b46b38c09a5e599c4fd603b4d08f15f7, and v4 09168659e304ffca278637a5dcbe45b589fd9503815b0bfd98ec4a07f20e7ed8.

Both Stage A verdict files exist on disk for each of v1 through v4, for eight omitted verdict pins. Their paired verdicts are v1 REJECT/REJECT, v2 REJECT/REJECT, v3 ACCEPT/REJECT, and v4 REJECT/ACCEPT; none of those four subjects was recorded by a COORD heading.
recordedInputs pins predecessor subjects v5 through v12 and their available verdicts but has no v1 through v4 subject or verdict path. authorityClaim's own-history recital likewise starts at v5.

The frozen-do-not-record boundary in doesNot[13] still names v7, v8, and v9 only. It was not extended to v11 as CLAUDE-PPBS-V12-B1 required, and it does not name v12 either, even though both are rejected and unrecorded.
This directly triggers the prompt's attack on any frozen version of this lineage that exists on disk and is not pinned.
blockers.impact: A later recording act cannot rely on these bytes as a complete lineage history or as the universal predecessor-and-verdict pin set the subject claims to provide.
requiredRepair: Add named predecessorV1 through predecessorV4 objects with their frozen subject paths and digests, accurate unrecorded standings, both on-disk Stage A verdict paths/digests/verdicts, and role sentences that do not attribute later content to the frozen files.
Add all twelve omitted subject/verdict paths to recordedInputs and extend authorityClaim and predecessorStanding to give the full frozen history.
Extend the frozen-do-not-record boundary to v11 and v12, and keep v10 explicitly distinguished as the current recorded baseline.

blockers.title: findingDisposition omits eight reviewer finding identifiers present on disk.
blockers.claimAttacked: The prompt requires the predecessor record to include every reviewer finding identifier on disk, and the subject presents findingDisposition as that landing record.
evidence: The frozen v1 through v12 Stage A verdict files contain 46 unique finding identifiers when only their blockers, shouldFix, advisories, and findings rosters are counted.
findingDisposition has 40 entries: two subject-minted NOTE identifiers and 38 of the 46 reviewer identifiers.
The eight omitted reviewer identifiers are CLAUDE-PPBS-V1-B1, CLAUDE-PPBS-V1-B2, PPBSV1-B1, PPBSV1-S1, CLAUDE-PPBS-V2-ADV-1, CLAUDE-PPBS-V10-ADV-1, CLAUDE-PPBS-V10-ADV-2, and CLAUDE-PPBS-V10-ADV-3.
D-316 expressly says the three CLAUDE-PPBS-V10 advisory identifiers travel as honesty work, so their omission is not explained by v10's ACCEPT verdict.

The two subject-minted identifiers PPBS-V13-CARRIED-STANDING and PPBS-V13-VENUE-NOTE use the distinct internal NOTE namespace and do not impersonate a reviewer finding; they do not cure the eight omissions.
blockers.impact: The purported repair provenance is incomplete and fails the prompt's explicit on-disk identifier closure test.
requiredRepair: Add an accurate disposition for each of the eight omitted reviewer identifiers, preserving whether it landed earlier, remains honesty work, or still stands.
Recompute the unique reviewer-identifier set from the frozen verdict rosters and prove exact closure against findingDisposition without counting attack-matrix or measurement identifiers as findings.

blockers.title: The new universal gradeRuling pin-shape claim is false, so required pin-shape findings are not fully landed.
blockers.claimAttacked: basedOn.predecessorPinningShape says each verdict object additionally carries the gradeRuling its verdict file states where that file states one; findingDisposition marks CLAUDE-PPBS-V12-ADV-3 LANDED.
evidence: Both preview-product-boundary-successor.v9 Stage A verdict files contain a top-level gradeRuling whose ruling is NOT SUSTAINED.
basedOn.predecessorV9.reviews.claude and basedOn.predecessorV9.reviews.codex each carry path, sha256, and verdict only; neither carries gradeRuling.

The v10, v11, and v12 verdict objects do carry gradeRuling where their files state one, which makes the two v9 omissions a direct exception to the newly universal sentence rather than a different object shape.
Because predecessorPinningShape remains contradicted by objects it describes, PPBSV11-B3 and CLAUDE-PPBS-V11-SF1 also are not fully landed despite their LANDED labels.
blockers.impact: The exact repair added to satisfy CLAUDE-PPBS-V12-ADV-3 makes a false universal claim in the field readers use instead of walking every predecessor object.
requiredRepair: Add gradeRuling NOT SUSTAINED to both v9 review objects, or state a narrower shape that precisely matches every pinned verdict object.
Re-check the final pin-shape sentence against every predecessor and join object before marking the related findings LANDED.

blockers.title: CLAUDE-PPBS-V12-ADV-4 is marked LANDED while basedOn.relation retains the exact broad claim it attacked.
blockers.claimAttacked: findingDisposition says authorityClaim and basedOn.relation now state what is held constant and what is added rather than asserting that nothing else changed.
evidence: authorityClaim was repaired: it enumerates the refreshed citations/partitions, D-316 standing, rejected-intermediate predecessor record, recomputed union, and the payload fields held constant.
basedOn.relation was not repaired in the same way. It still says the subject refreshes the citations and partitions 'and changes nothing else', the exact phrase CLAUDE-PPBS-V12-ADV-4 identified.

Relative to v10, these bytes also add the measured D-316 standing, v11/v12 predecessor objects and standings, six recordedInputs rows, seventeen reviewer-finding dispositions, and the v12 advisory repairs. basedOn.relation names none of those additions before its broad changes-nothing-else clause.
The only substantive addition to relation from v12 is a malformed predecessor sentence; the held-constant/addition inventory remains absent.
blockers.impact: One of the seventeen mandatory findings is not fully landed, and a disposition asserts a repair that the named bytes do not show.
requiredRepair: Replace the broad changes-nothing-else clause in basedOn.relation with the same precise additions and held-constant categories authorityClaim now states.
Keep the normalized class equality claim scoped to the fourteen class payloads rather than using it as a whole-artifact no-change claim.
